query:
SELECT wt.id, wt.name, wt.description, COUNT(ws.id) as stage_count
FROM workflow_templates wt
LEFT JOIN workflow_stages ws ON wt.id = ws.workflowTemplateId
GROUP BY wt.id, wt.name, wt.description
ORDER BY wt.id;
